meta.title: Futures Friends | 38-child 12-month pilot
meta.status: Conditional planning estimate; positive operating margin before building payments and debt at the planning assumptions; owner-director unpaid
meta.scope: One owned location, ages 2–5; first-month checkpoint; national expansion deferred.

lines.notes: Total planning roster, not all new hires. 52 paid weeks include closure/training allowance; actual roster and hours must replace estimates. All staff $16/hr (owner-confirmed 2026-10-13); above Missouri 2026 minimum wage $15.00. Ages 2–5 · 38 children all day · 4 caregivers on the floor in two groups of ≤20 (Missouri 1:10, ≤4 two-year-olds per group; 5 CSR 25-500.112). Meals prepared by staff; food costs retained. No paid substitutes — the floater covers absences, leaving breaks uncovered on those days.

assumptions.tuition_basis: Owner-confirmed 2026-10-13: locked-in rate of $210/week per child (session enrollment), converted using 52/12 = $910/month; assumes 52 billed weeks; no tuition increases assumed; sibling discounts would lower realized revenue.
assumptions.past_creator_fees: Excluded pending signed deliverables, payments and rights reconciliation

funding.financing_status: Cost estimate, not a financeable loan request. Positive ongoing operating margin before building payments and debt, with the owner as unpaid director; mortgage, debt, lender fees and past creator invoice unresolved.

staffing.director: Owner serves as director (unpaid); a market director salary (~$60k all-in) is excluded. Missouri requires a qualified director on duty 40 h/wk (5 CSR 25-500.102(2)).
staffing.ratio_note: Ages 2–5 · 38 children all day · 4 caregivers on the floor in two groups of ≤20 (Missouri 1:10, ≤4 two-year-olds per group; 5 CSR 25-500.112).
staffing.ratio_basis: 5 CSR 25-500.112: mixed ages 2+ with ≤4 two-year-olds per group 1:10, max group 20; >4 two-year-olds 1:8, max 16
staffing.coverage: All-day care for 38 children: four full-time caregivers on the floor in two groups of ≤20; a part-time floater covers breaks and lunch relief; no food worker (meals prepared by staff; food costs retained); no paid substitutes (the floater covers absences, leaving breaks uncovered on those days); the owner is the unpaid director.

schedule.people: Four full-time caregivers in two groups of ≤20
